args.body: For CATALOGUE-COMMISSIONED-REVIEW-OFFER, read the inline intake test if its receipt confirms commitment. The fictional request encodes both CSVs and a change brief in one plain-text message. It tests the proposed format only. Compare the actual private-cycle intake contract and live offer with that request once the worked-report prerequisite is met. If both inputs fit, use the verified checker report to prepare the smallest bilingual offer revision and request independent exact-digest review. If the authorized intake cannot carry both inputs, identify the precise mismatch and test whether a narrower request preserves the demonstrated buyer decision. Do not send mail or deploy.

description: Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so buyer response and conversion are unknown. Lemon Squeezy’s documented new-seller closure stops that checkout route. The commissioned catalogue review can still be tested through the existing inbound channel. This turn tests whether one inline request can carry the before and after CSVs and the approval brief needed to make a useful decision. A verified worked report and host-enforced independent review remain prerequisites for a public offer revision. The November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement remain scheduled.
